limitations: This verifies the 14-stage snapshot, not current remaining-stage completion.
Durations use logged launch UTC plus local cursor filesystem mtimes and include loading, hashing, checkpoint/progress overhead and guards; they are not pure GPU or generation times.
Cursor content hashes do not cryptographically bind filesystem mtimes; timestamp reproduction is local provenance, not a portable signed runtime measurement.
The 1.5x multiplier, 0.5h allowance and historical per-case/load coefficients are planning assumptions; historical coefficients were not rederived in this narrow check.
No probabilistic completion interval, hardware availability guarantee, remaining-model accuracy estimate or MRI generalization claim.
privacy: Aggregate is safe: no case/patient IDs, private paths, raw responses, token arrays, targets or accuracy values.
